Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) TransceiverModePtr Requested mode of requested network the Transceiver is connected to. Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: Transceiver mode request has been accepted. E_NOT_OK: Transceiver mode request has not been accepted. Description This function invokes CanTrcv_GetOpMode and updates the parameter TransceiverModePtr with the value OpMode provided by CanTrcv. Available via CanIf.h
